verdict.rationale: Site crawling is a fair question for a web search and content-extraction API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-page capabilities: ranked results with extracted page text, a URL-fetch agent tool, and general-purpose agentic browsing via Computer. None of these is a documented capability to crawl subpages or whole sites from a search result, so they are adjacent features at most.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can crawl subpages or entire sites starting from a search result
